en: Abu Bakr al-Razi
zh: 拉齐 al-Razi, Abu Bakr (Peter Adamson)

en: **First published Wed May 19, 2021; substantive revision Wed May 14, 2025**
zh: ** 首次发表于 2021 年 5 月 19 日；2025 年 5 月 14 日实质修订。**

en: Abū Bakr al-Rāzī (865–925 CE, 251–313 AH) was one of the greatest figures in the history of medicine in the Islamic tradition, and one of its most controversial philosophers. While we have ample surviving evidence for his medical thought, his philosophical ideas mostly have to be pieced together on the basis of reports found in other authors, who are often hostile to him. This concerns especially his notorious critique of religion, and his teaching that the cosmos is produced through the interaction of five “eternal principles”, namely God, Soul, matter, time, and place. We do however have direct access to one branch of his philosophy, namely ethics, represented by a work of advice called *The Spiritual Medicine* and a briefer rejoinder to his critics, *The Philosophical Way of Life*. (Note that Abū Bakr is not to be confused with other philosophers from the same city of Rayy, who are also called al-Rāzī: the most famous of these is Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī, who wrote several centuries later.)
zh: 阿布·伯克尔·拉齐（Abū Bakr al-Rāzī，公元 865–925 年，回历 251–313 年）是伊斯兰传统医学史上最伟大的人物之一，也是其中最有争议的哲学家之一。关于他的医学思想，我们拥有充足的传世材料；但他的哲学理念大多只能依据其他作者——他们往往对他怀有敌意——所载的转述拼合起来。这尤其涉及他臭名昭著的对宗教的批评，以及他的这样一个学说：宇宙是通过五个“永恒原理”的相互作用产生的，即上帝、灵魂、质料、时间与处所。不过，他的哲学有一个分支我们可以直接读到，那就是伦理学，其代表是《精神医学》这部劝诫之作，以及对批评者的一个较简短的回击《哲学的生活方式》。（注意：不要把阿布·伯克尔与来自同一城市赖伊的其他也叫拉齐的哲学家混淆：其中最有名的是法赫尔丁·拉齐，晚他数个世纪。）

en: 1. Life and Works
zh: 1 生平与著作

en: Abū Bakr Muḥammad ibn Zakariyyāʾ al-Rāzī made his fame mostly as a doctor. As his name “al-Rāzī” indicates, he hailed from the Persian city of Rayy, near modern-day Tehran. His biographers report that he ran a hospital there, and another in Baghdad. He received patronage from Abū Ṣāliḥ al-Manṣūr (d. 914), the governor of Rayy, to whom al-Rāzī dedicated a substantial medical treatise, *The Book for al-Manṣūr*. We have a variety of anecdotes about al-Rāzī’s medical practice, some found in his own works and some in his medieval biographers, for instance that al-Rāzī would deal only with patients whose condition stumped his students. We also know, because he tells us himself, that he suffered from eye problems and a hand injury from copious reading, copying, and writing.
zh: 阿布·伯克尔·穆罕默德·本·扎卡里亚·拉齐主要以医生闻名。如他的名字“拉齐”（al-Rāzī）所示，他来自波斯城市赖伊，靠近今天的德黑兰。其传记作者记载他在那里经营一所医院，在巴格达还经营另一所。他得到赖伊总督阿布·萨利赫·曼苏尔（卒于 914 年）的赞助，并把一部重要的医学论著《献给曼苏尔的书》献给他。关于拉齐行医的轶事不少，有些见于他本人的著作，有些见于中世纪的传记作者——例如，拉齐只诊治那些把他的学生都难倒的病人。我们还知道（因为他自己说的），由于大量阅读、抄写与写作，他饱受眼疾与手伤之苦。

en: This latter piece of information is found in *The Philosophical Way of Life*, which is a good first text to read by al-Rāzī (Arabic edition in al-Rāzī RF; English translation in al-Rāzī PWL). In it he rebuts accusations that he is a hypocrite for claiming to model his lifestyle on that of Socrates, when in fact Socrates was rigorously ascetic and al-Rāzī is not (see Strohmaier 1974)[^strohmaier-1974]. Al-Rāzī responds by saying that reports of Socrates’ asceticism, which unbeknownst to him go back to a confusion in the sources between Socrates and Diogenes the Cynic, do not tell the whole story. In fact Socrates adopted a lifestyle of moderation as he matured, and it is this model that al-Rāzī imitates.
zh: 后一条信息见于《哲学的生活方式》，这是阅读拉齐的一篇很好的入门文本（阿拉伯语编本见 al-Rāzī RF；英译见 al-Rāzī PWL）。在这篇文字里，他反驳了关于他伪善的指控：他声称效仿苏格拉底的生活方式，而苏格拉底实际上是严格的苦行者，拉齐却不是（见 Strohmaier 1974）[^strohmaier-1974]。拉齐回应说：关于苏格拉底苦行的种种传闻——他并不知情的是，这些传闻源于文献中把苏格拉底与犬儒第欧根尼的混淆——并未道出全貌。事实上，苏格拉底随着成熟而采纳了一种节制的生活方式，拉齐效仿的正是这个榜样。

en: This is one of only two complete surviving works by al-Rāzī devoted solely to a philosophical topic; the other one also deals with ethics. This is *The Spiritual Medicine* (Arabic edition in al-Rāzī RF; English translation in al-Rāzī SPR and for discussion Adamson 2016)[^adamson-2016], a longer book of ethical advice presented to his patron al-Manṣūr as a complement to the aforementioned medical treatise. Here al-Rāzī offers treatment for the soul, following on his overview of treatments for the body (Adamson 2019)[^adamson-2019]. Apart from this, the most significant surviving work for his philosophy is his *Doubts about Galen* (Arabic critical edition and translation by Koetschet in al-Rāzī DG). Al-Rāzī considered Galen the greatest of medical authorities, but on the basis of Galen’s own critical attitude towards esteemed predecessors, felt free to critique weak points in the extensive corpus of Galenic works that had been translated into Arabic. While a number of these points naturally concern medicine, the *Doubts* also touches on a wide range of philosophical issues, as discussed below.
zh: 这是拉齐传世的、专门讨论哲学主题的仅有的两部完整著作之一；另一部处理的也是伦理学。它就是《精神医学》（阿拉伯语编本见 al-Rāzī RF；英译见 al-Rāzī SPR，讨论见 Adamson 2016）[^adamson-2016]，一部更长的伦理劝诫之作，献给其赞助人曼苏尔，作为前述医学论著的补充。在此书中，拉齐为灵魂提供治疗，接续其对身体治疗的概述（Adamson 2019）[^adamson-2019]。除此之外，对其哲学而言最重要的传世著作是他的《对盖伦的质疑》（阿拉伯语批判版与翻译见 Koetschet 编 al-Rāzī DG）。拉齐视盖伦为最伟大的医学权威，但基于盖伦本人对受尊崇的前辈的批判态度，他觉得自己可以自由批评已译成阿拉伯语的盖伦庞大著作群中的薄弱之处。虽然这些质疑中有不少自然关乎医学，《质疑》也触及广泛的哲学问题，下文将讨论。

en: Beyond this, the extant writings have to do mostly with medicine, including a number of smaller treatises, like a celebrated text on the difference between smallpox and measles (English translation in al-Rāzī SM), and the by no means small *Comprehensive Book*, a staggeringly huge collection of notes on medicine that was compiled by al-Rāzī’s students after his death. The *Comprehensive Book* is sometimes said to present al-Rāzī’s “case notes”. But, while it is true that he reports on his own medical experiences, the work is more accurately described as a collection of excerpts from Greek and Arabic medical sources. When he does introduce “case notes” this is to provide counterexamples and amplifications for the textual evidence (Savage-Smith 2012)[^savage-smith-2012]. Broadly speaking, despite his often harsh diatribe against Galen’s failures in the *Doubts*, al-Rāzī’s own medical theories fall broadly within the Galenic framework, and thus deploy such standard concepts as the four humors, the natural powers of the body, and the role of *pneuma* in explaining animal sensation and motion.
zh: 此外，传世著作大多与医学有关，包括若干较小的论著，如一篇论述天花与麻疹之别的著名文本（英译见 al-Rāzī SM），以及绝非小部头的《集成》——一部规模惊人的医学笔记汇编，由拉齐的学生在其身后编纂。《集成》有时被说成呈现了拉齐的“病例笔记”。但虽然他确实记录了自己的行医经验，更准确地说，此书是对希腊与阿拉伯医学文献的摘录汇编。当他引入“病例笔记”时，是为了给文本证据提供反例与扩充（Savage-Smith 2012）[^savage-smith-2012]。大体而言，尽管拉齐在《质疑》中对盖伦的失败有过严词抨击，他自己的医学理论仍大体落在盖伦式框架之内，因而使用了四体液、身体的自然力、以及以普纽玛（*pneuma*）解释动物感觉与运动这类标准概念。

en: A final group of works that come down to us from al-Rāzī discuss alchemy (Ruska 1935)[^ruska-1935]. He was evidently a practicing alchemist and describes in detail a wide variety of chemical procedures, all aimed towards the goal of manufacturing valuable minerals and stones, or likenesses thereof. It may be that al-Rāzī’s atomist theory of matter provided him with a basis for understanding these processes. Chemical transformation would involve breaking down complex substances to more primitive particles and then recombining them in other proportions to produce the desired result (Kraus 1942–3: vol. 2, 10–11; Adamson 2021: 96–98)[^adamson-2021][^kraus-1942].
zh: 最后一批传世作品讨论炼金术（Ruska 1935）[^ruska-1935]。他显然是一位从事实践的炼金术士，详细描述了各种各样的化学流程，全都指向制造贵重的矿物与宝石或其仿品的目标。拉齐的原子论质料理论或许为他理解这些过程提供了基础：化学转变可以包括把复杂物质分解为更基本的粒子，再按别的比例重新组合以产生想要的结果（Kraus 1942–3: vol. 2, 10–11; Adamson 2021: 96–98）[^adamson-2021][^kraus-1942]。

en: Beyond these extant works we have reports on the full range of al-Rāzī’s writings by later authors who recorded lists of their titles. These confirm that he wrote much on medicine, philosophy, and alchemy, as well as mathematics, logic, and poetry. Most eye-catching here, though, are works in which he discussed religion and, especially, prophecy. The latter bear titles like *On the Tricks of Supposed Prophets* and *On the Necessity of the Prophetic Mission*. That could just show that he was concerned to refute the claims of spurious prophets, while accepting the legitimacy of true prophets. But in reports by still other authors, we are given a picture of al-Rāzī as a fundamentally anti-religious author who rejected all revelation and prophecy. This is especially the case with al-Rāzī’s contemporary, also from Rayy, Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī (d. 934). In a treatise called *The Proofs of Prophecy*, Abū Ḥātim recounts face-to-face debates he had with al-Rāzī and then summarizes, and elaborately refutes, a treatise by al-Rāzī that supposedly sought to unmask the falsehoods of all revelatory religious traditions (see AHR in the bibliography).
zh: 在这些传世著作之外，我们还有后世作者记录的拉齐全部著述的清单。它们证实他写了大量关于医学、哲学与炼金术的东西，还有数学、逻辑与诗歌。不过这里最引人注目的，是他讨论宗教、尤其是预言的著作。后者带有《论所谓先知的伎俩》与《论先知使命的必然性》这样的标题。这可能只说明他致力于驳斥假先知的主张，同时接受真先知的合法性。但在另一些作者的转述中，拉齐被描绘成一位根本性的反宗教作者，拒斥一切启示与预言。尤其如此的是与拉齐同代、同样来自赖伊的阿布·哈蒂姆·拉齐（卒于 934 年）。在一部题为《预言的证明》的论著中，阿布·哈蒂姆讲述了他们面对面辩论的经过，随后概括并细致驳斥了拉齐的一部论著——据称后者试图揭露一切启示性宗教传统的虚妄（见文献 AHR）。

en: Along with Abū Ḥātim, two other sources are crucial for reconstructing al-Rāzī’s cosmology. These are Naṣīr-e Khosraw (d. 1088), who explained this cosmology in order to refute it in his Persian work *Provision for the Traveler* (hereafter NK, selective trans. into Arabic in al-Rāzī RF), and yet another al-Rāzī, this time the famous theologian-philosopher Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī (d. 1210), in his *Exalted Topics* (hereafter FDR). From these and a few other sources, we can piece together the details of a remarkable account of the creation of the world, which invokes five factors that have always existed and come together to produce the cosmos: God, Soul, matter, time, and place. Abū Ḥātim and Naṣīr-e Khosraw both present this as an appalling departure from Islam, since it involves postulating four eternal principles alongside God.
zh: 与阿布·哈蒂姆一道，另有两条材料对重构拉齐的宇宙论至关重要。其一是纳赛尔·霍斯鲁（卒于 1088 年），他在波斯语著作《旅人的干粮》中阐述了这一宇宙论以便驳斥它（下文称 NK，节选的阿拉伯语译文见 al-Rāzī RF）；其二是又一位拉齐——著名的神学家-哲学家法赫尔丁·拉齐（卒于 1210 年），见其《崇高论题》（下文称 FDR）。从这些以及少数其他材料，我们可以拼合出关于世界创造的一套惊人说明的细节：它诉诸五个一直存在、共同作用而产生宇宙的因素——上帝、灵魂、质料、时间与处所。阿布·哈蒂姆与纳赛尔·霍斯鲁都把这一点呈现为对伊斯兰的骇人背离，因为它在上帝之旁设定了四个永恒原理。

en: 2. The Five Eternal Principles
zh: 2 五大永恒原理

en: Some reports suggest that al-Rāzī saw his five principles as having a systematic structure: God and Soul are active and alive, matter passive and non-living, and time and place neither active, nor passive, nor alive. But the scheme does not seem to be motivated by its ability to satisfy all logical possibilities. Rather, al-Rāzī argues specifically for each of the five principles. God’s existence is demonstrated on the basis of the good design of the universe; more contentious are the other four.
zh: 有些转述提示，拉齐认为他的五个原理具有一个系统结构：上帝与灵魂主动而有生命，质料被动而无生命，时间与处所既不主动、也不被动、也无生命。但这个图式似乎并非因其能穷尽一切逻辑可能而得到辩护。毋宁说，拉齐对五个原理中的每一个都专门论证。上帝的存在依据宇宙的良好设计得到证明；其余四个则更有争议。

en: While the Soul is invoked as the source of life in bodies, its primary function in al-Rāzī’s philosophy is to facilitate a distinctive theodicy. The presence of great suffering in the world, alongside the aforementioned good design of that world, shows that it cannot have been created directly by God. Furthermore, al-Rāzī is concerned with a traditional argument against the eternity of the universe, namely that a perfectly wise and rational God could not arbitrarily choose a moment for the universe to begin existing. Both problems are solved by postulating a Soul which is “foolish” where God is wise. The Soul conceives of a desire or even passion (*ʿishq*) to be “mixed” with matter, which initiates the process of the world’s creation. God intervenes to make the world as good as it can be, but our bodily life is still inevitably full of pain.
zh: 灵魂被援引为身体中生命的来源，但它在拉齐哲学中的主要功能，是促成一种独特的神义论。世界上存在巨大的苦难，与前面提到的世界之良好设计并存，这表明世界不可能是上帝直接创造的。此外，拉齐还关心一个反对宇宙永恒的传统论证：一个全然智慧而理性的上帝不可能任意选定一个时刻让宇宙开始存在。这两个问题都通过设定一个灵魂而得到解决——这个灵魂“愚蠢”，而上帝智慧。灵魂生出一个要与质料“混合”的欲望乃至爱欲（*ʿishq*），由此启动世界的创造过程。上帝介入其中，使世界尽可能好，但我们的身体生命仍不可避免地充满痛苦。

en: One question that arises here is why God would not prevent the Soul from mixing with matter, if this is such a bad idea. Al-Rāzī’s explanation is that God allows it to happen as a learning experience for the Soul (Goodman 1975)[^goodman-1975]. God bestows upon the Soul the gift of reason or intellect (*ʿaql*), and Soul can use this to realize that it should be working to free itself from its unwise bond with matter (Druart 1996)[^druart-1996]. We have reports of parables used by al-Rāzī to explain this. A wise father might allow his inexperienced child to venture to a dangerous country, but send with him a good advisor (namely the intellect; Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī, FDR: vol. 4, 416). Similarly, a wise father might allow his foolish child to go into an alluring garden full of thorns and stinging insects, so as to teach the child a lesson (Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, AHR: 18–19). This theodicy points the way towards a conception of our ultimate end, namely to escape from the material world, achieving “liberation” through moderate lifestyle and the practice of philosophy.
zh: 这里产生的一个问题是：如果与质料混合是如此糟糕的主意，上帝为什么不阻止灵魂这样做？拉齐的解释是：上帝允许它发生，是把它作为灵魂的一次学习经历（Goodman 1975）[^goodman-1975]。上帝把理性或理智（*ʿaql*）作为礼物赐予灵魂，灵魂可以借此认识到，自己应当努力从不明智的与质料的束缚中解脱出来（Druart 1996）[^druart-1996]。我们还有拉齐用以解释这一点的寓言的转述。一位睿智的父亲或许会允许他稚嫩的孩子去一个危险的国度闯荡，但会派一位好的顾问随行（即理智；法赫尔丁·拉齐，FDR: vol. 4, 416）。同样，一位睿智的父亲或许会允许他愚笨的孩子进入一座满是荆棘与毒虫的诱人花园，好让孩子吸取教训（阿布·哈蒂姆·拉齐，AHR: 18–19）。这一神义论为我们的终极归宿指示了方向：逃离物质世界，通过节制的生活方式与哲学实践达致“解脱”。

en: As for matter, time, and place, these principles are required in order that the universe may be created at all (for an overview see Fakhry 1968)[^fakhry-1968]. First, al-Rāzī thinks that there must already be some material before the cosmos exists, out of which it is constructed. As Nāṣir-e Khosraw (NK: 75) complains, al-Rāzī believed that creation *ex nihilo* was impossible. He argued for this on the grounds that we constantly see things being produced through lengthy processes of development, even though instantaneous manifestation would be far easier and involve less suffering: he gives the example of the need for childbirth and growth to maturity. His point is that God would not cause this to happen, if He could just make humans exist from nothing. Time and place are needed for an analogous reason. Time cannot be created, since creation must occur *at* a time, and place cannot be created, because there would already need to be somewhere to put it.
zh: 至于质料、时间与处所，这三个原理是宇宙得以被创造的前提（概述见 Fakhry 1968）[^fakhry-1968]。首先，拉齐认为在宇宙存在之前必须已有某种质料，宇宙由之构造而成。正如纳赛尔·霍斯鲁（NK: 75）抱怨的，拉齐相信从无中创造是不可能的。他为此辩护的理由是：我们不断看到事物经由漫长的发展过程被产生出来，即使瞬间的显现会容易得多、也少些痛苦——他举的例子是生育与成长至成熟之必要。他的要点是：如果上帝能从无中直接造出人来，他就不会让这一切发生。时间与处所之需要出于类似的理由。时间不可能被创造，因为创造必须在 ** 某个 ** 时间发生；处所不可能被创造，因为必须先有某个地方来安放它。

en: Al-Rāzī’s conception of matter is unusual among *falāsifa*, that is, thinkers of the Islamic world who respond primarily to the Greek philosophical tradition. More or less all of them, from al-Kindī (d. after 870) to al-Fārābī (d. 950), Ibn Sīnā (Avicenna, d. 1037), and Ibn Rushd (Averroes, d. 1198), endorse a broadly Aristotelian understanding of bodies as potentially subject to indefinite division. By contrast, al-Rāzī is an atomist (Pines 1936 [1997], Baffioni 1982, Langermann 2009)[^baffioni-1982][^langermann-2009][^pines-1936]. He believes that the four elements (or possibly five: our sources are not clear as to whether he thinks the heavens are constituted from a distinct fifth element) differ in their properties because of variations in the ratio of atoms to void. Thus earth, which has little or no void in it, is dark, cold, dense, and moves downward; fire is luminous, hot, subtle, and moves upward. Actually these are not strictly “elements” but only the most basic compounds of atoms, which are truly fundamental. Though contemporary Islamic theologians were also atomists (Dhanani 1994)[^dhanani-1994], al-Rāzī’s theory differs from theirs in some respects, and we know that he debated the topic of matter with a theologian named al-Miṣmaʿī.
zh: 拉齐的质料观在法拉西卡（falāsifa，即主要回应希腊哲学传统的伊斯兰世界思想家）之中是不寻常的。他们几乎所有人——从铿迪（卒于 870 年之后）到法拉比（卒于 950 年）、伊本·西那（阿维森纳，卒于 1037 年）与伊本·鲁世德（阿威罗伊，卒于 1198 年）——都认可一种广义亚里士多德式的物体观：物体潜在地可作无限分割。相比之下，拉齐是一个原子论者（Pines 1936 [1997], Baffioni 1982, Langermann 2009）[^baffioni-1982][^langermann-2009][^pines-1936]。他相信四元素（或者可能是五种：我们的材料并不清楚他是否认为诸天由一个独特的第五元素构成）之所以性质各异，是因为原子与虚空的配比不同。于是，虚空很少或没有虚空的土是暗的、冷的、致密的，向下运动；火是明亮的、热的、精微的，向上运动。实际上这些并非严格意义的“元素”，而只是原子的最基本化合物——原子才是真正根本的。虽然同时代的伊斯兰教义学家也是原子论者（Dhanani 1994）[^dhanani-1994]，拉齐的理论在某些方面与他们不同，而且我们知道他曾与一位名叫米斯马伊的神学家辩论质料问题。

en: Al-Rāzī referred to atoms as “absolute (*muṭlaq*) matter”, a locution echoed in his characterizations of the last two principles, namely “absolute time” and “absolute place”. These are also known, respectively, as “eternity (*dahr*)” or “duration (*mudda*)” and “void (*khalāʾ*)”. As we learn from the report of the debate with Abū Ḥātim, al-Rāzī was concerned to stress the independence of time and place from bodies, that is, from composites of atoms (Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, AHR: 12). Time in itself is simply eternal duration, with events (including the creation of the world) and motions happening within that duration. Similarly, place in itself is an infinite void, into which the bounded physical cosmos is placed. As already explained, void also exists (at least at the microscopic level) within the cosmos, since its admixture into bodies explains the variation between the elements.
zh: 拉齐把原子称为“绝对的（*muṭlaq*）质料”，这一措辞也回响在他对后两个原理的刻画上：“绝对时间”与“绝对处所”。它们分别又被称为“永恒（*dahr*）”或“延续（*mudda*）”与“虚空（*khalāʾ*）”。正如与阿布·哈蒂姆辩论的记录所示，拉齐着意强调时间与处所独立于物体——即独立于原子的复合物（阿布·哈蒂姆·拉齐，AHR: 12）。时间本身无非是永恒的延续，诸事件（包括世界的创造）与诸运动在其中发生。类似地，处所本身是一个无限的虚空，有界的物理宇宙被安放于其中。如前所述，虚空也存在于宇宙之内（至少在微观层面上），因为虚空混入物体解释了诸元素之间的差异。

en: Al-Rāzī’s theories may be usefully contrasted to those of Aristotle; we know he was familiar with Aristotle’s *Physics* because he tells us as much in his *Philosophical Way of Life*. For Aristotle, time and place are dependent or supervenient phenomena: place is the inner boundary of the body that contains the body that is in place, while time is the number of motion. Al-Rāzī by contrast makes space-time independent. For instance he proposed a thought experiment that, if the universe were taken away, its place would remain (a similar idea is proposed by Philoponus *in Phys.* 574, translated in Philoponus CPV: 36). However his attitude towards Aristotelian physics is more nuanced than straightforward rejection (Adamson 2021: ch.5)[^adamson-2021]. For he accepts that one may speak of “relative” time and place, which would be the time and place of a particular motion and particular body, respectively. For example a year would be a demarcated segment of eternal duration that measures the sun’s motion along the ecliptic, while the place of a ball would be the limit of the region of void occupied by the ball. Likewise, al-Rāzī includes the Aristotelian elements, earth, water, air, fire, and perhaps ether, in his cosmology but does not accept that these are fundamental. As just seen, the real “element” that underlies them is atomic.
zh: 拉齐的理论可以与亚里士多德的理论作有益的对照；我们知道他熟悉亚里士多德的《物理学》，因为他在《哲学的生活方式》中亲自说了这一点。对亚里士多德而言，时间与处所是依赖性或随附性的现象：处所是包含处于某处之物体的那个物体的内边界，而时间是运动的数目。拉齐则使时空独立。例如他提出一个思想实验：如果把宇宙拿走，它的处所仍将存在（菲洛波努斯在《物理学注》574 提出了类似的想法，译文见 Philoponus CPV: 36）。不过，他对亚里士多德物理学的态度比简单的拒斥更微妙（Adamson 2021: ch.5）[^adamson-2021]。因为他接受人们可以谈论“相对的”时间与处所——那将是某个特定运动的时间与某个特定物体的处所。例如，一年将是永恒延续中被划出的一个区段，用于度量太阳沿黄道的运动；而一个球的处所将是该球所占据的虚空区域的界限。同样，拉齐把亚里士多德的诸元素——土、水、气、火，或许还有以太——纳入其宇宙论，但不接受它们是根本的。如刚才所见，作为其基础的真正“元素”是原子性的。

en: Thus Aristotle managed to articulate genuine principles of physics, but only “relative” ones that need to be understood within a more basic framework. It was Plato who, in al-Rāzī’s opinion, had gotten closest to putting forward that framework. Abū Ḥātim says that al-Rāzī told him as much: “what Plato says is hardly different from what I believe concerning time, and this, according to me, is the best thing that has been said about it” (Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, AHR: 13). The text he must have in mind is Plato’s *Timaeus*, which he would have known through the intermediary of Galen (see Galen, CTP for the Arabic translation of his paraphrase of the dialogue). The *Timaeus* likewise postulates a pre-existing matter that is formed into the cosmos; it can also be read as suggesting that time and place in some sense pre-exist the cosmos. Furthermore, Plato puts forward an atomic theory in the *Timaeus*. In fact, al-Rāzī rises to the defense of that theory in *Doubts about Galen* (al-Rāzī, DG: §15.1-6). So there is good reason to believe that al-Rāzī was modeling his cosmology primarily on Plato’s, as he understood it, albeit with adjustments.
zh: 于是，亚里士多德成功地表述了真正的物理学原理，但只是“相对的”原理，需要在更基本的框架内来理解。在拉齐看来，最接近提出那个框架的是柏拉图。阿布·哈蒂姆说拉齐对他亲口讲过：“柏拉图关于时间的说法与我所信的几乎没有不同，而依我看，这是关于时间所说出过的最好的话”（阿布·哈蒂姆·拉齐，AHR: 13）。他心里想的文本必定是柏拉图的《蒂迈欧篇》，他会是经由盖伦的中介知道它的（盖伦对该对话的意译之阿拉伯语译本，见 Galen, CTP）。《蒂迈欧篇》同样设定了一种先在的质料，宇宙由之被赋形；它也可以被读作暗示时间与处所在某种意义上先于宇宙而存在。此外，柏拉图在《蒂迈欧篇》中提出了一种原子论。事实上，拉齐在《对盖伦的质疑》中挺身捍卫了那一理论（al-Rāzī, DG: §15.1-6）。因此，很有理由相信：拉齐主要是照他所理解的柏拉图的宇宙论来建立自己的宇宙论的，尽管有所调整。

en: On the other hand, Naṣīr-e Khosraw tells us that al-Rāzī plagiarized this whole theory from his teacher, Īrānshahrī. He is an obscure figure whose works are lost, though al-Bīrūnī (d. ca. 1050) does speak of him as an expert in astronomy and the diversity of religions. Another witness, Abū l-Maʿālī (fl. 1092), has Īrānshahrī claiming to have been a prophet who had received revelation from an angel, like the Prophet Muhammad did. He reports that for Īrānshahrī, all religions put forth a single teaching, an idea which might be thought to resonate with al-Rāzī’s own irenic, rationalist approach to revelation. If Naṣīr-e Khosraw is right to trace the Razian cosmology to this shadowy teacher, then perhaps we should think of al-Rāzī’s project as a creative fusion of Īrānshahri’s ideas and Plato’s.
zh: 另一方面，纳赛尔·霍斯鲁告诉我们，拉齐这整套理论是从他的老师伊兰沙赫里那里剽窃来的。伊兰沙赫里是个晦暗不明的人物，其著作已佚，不过比鲁尼（卒于约 1050 年）确实称他为天文学与宗教多样性的专家。另一位见证者阿布·马阿利（活跃于 1092 年）则让伊兰沙赫里自称是先知，像先知穆罕默德那样从天使那里领受启示。他记载说，按伊兰沙赫里的看法，一切宗教提出的都是同一个教导——这一想法或许可以认为与拉齐自己对启示的调和方法论立场相呼应。如果纳赛尔·霍斯鲁把拉齐式宇宙论追溯到这位隐秘的老师是对的，那么或许我们应当把拉齐的工程看作伊兰沙赫里的想法与柏拉图的创造性融合。

en: 3. Ethics
zh: 3 伦理学

en: From the foregoing discussion of al-Rāzī’s theodicy it may seem obvious that his ethical teaching would focus on the goal of liberation from the body and its concerns. But as mentioned already, his *Philosophical Way of Life* defends a lifestyle of moderation, and distances itself from outright asceticism. Furthermore, in this text he says that bodily pleasure may licitly be sought so long as one does not transgress what he calls a “limit past which one may not go”. This limit dictates that we should partake of no pleasures
zh: 从前文关于拉齐神义论的讨论看，他的伦理教导似乎显然会聚焦于从身体及其牵挂中解脱的目标。但如前所述，他的《哲学的生活方式》为一种节制的生活方式辩护，并与彻底的苦行保持距离。此外，他在该文本中说，可以正当地追求身体快乐，只要不逾越他所谓的“不可逾越之限”。这一界限规定我们不得享用那些

en: that can be attained only by engaging in evildoing, murder, and in general anything that displeases God, when the judgment of intellect and justice is that it is unnecessary. All else is permitted. (al-Rāzī, RF: 106–7)
zh: 只有通过作恶、杀戮，以及一般而言任何令上帝不悦之事才能获得的快乐，当理智与正义的判断认为这并无必要之时。其余一切皆可。（al-Rāzī, RF: 106–7）

en: On the other hand, in the *Spiritual Medicine* he seems to take a dim view of pleasures, and offers advice for resisting the allure of food, drink, sex, and luxury. One point made in both works is that it is a violation of reason to enjoy things that entail more pain than pleasure in the long run, like overeating. In the *Spiritual Medicine* al-Rāzī tells the story of how he chastized a man who gobbled down a plate of dates, warning him that it would lead to illnesses, and thus “many times more pain than the pleasure you have had” (al-Rāzī, RF: 71).
zh: 另一方面，在《精神医学》中他对快乐的评价似乎颇为负面，并为抵御食物、酒、性与奢侈的诱惑提供建议。两篇文字共有的一点是：享受那些从长远看带来的痛苦多于快乐的东西（如暴食）是对理性的违背。在《精神医学》中，拉齐讲了他如何训斥一个狼吞虎咽吃掉一盘椰枣的人，警告他这会导致疾病，从而带来“比你已享有的快乐多许多倍的痛苦”（al-Rāzī, RF: 71）。

en: Two interpretations have been offered to explain al-Rāzī’s position on pleasure. According to Lenn E. Goodman (1971, 1999, followed by Groff 2014)[^groff-2014], al-Rāzī was defending an Epicurean ethic in which pleasure should be maximized. On this account, his rationale for moderation is that it is the way to have the most pleasure: going too far with pleasures turns out to be more painful in the long run. This interpretation has been criticized by Adamson (2008a, 2021), on the grounds that it ignores al-Rāzī’s own theory of pleasure. According to this theory, which is clearly based on the *Timaeus*, pleasure can be had only as the result of a process of removing a harmful state. For example, drinking is pleasant because it eliminates thirst. On this account of pleasure, as Plato himself pointed out, hedonism is an attempt to win at a zero-sum game: you can only have pleasure to the extent that you have suffered pain, or at least harm. (Not all harm is felt as pain, just as not all restoration is felt as pleasure, because only fast changes are noticeable.) Furthermore, al-Rāzī says himself in the *Doubts about Galen* (DG: §7.7) that pleasure is *not* the good to be sought in itself, which is a direct rejection of the sort of hedonism adopted in Epicureanism.
zh: 为解释拉齐在快乐问题上的立场，已有两种诠释。按 Lenn E. Goodman（1971, 1999；Groff 2014 从之）[^groff-2014]的看法，拉齐在捍卫一种伊壁鸠鲁式伦理，其中快乐应当被最大化。按这种解读，他主张节制的理由是：节制是获得最多快乐的方式——在快乐上走得过远，长远看会更痛苦。这一诠释受到 Adamson（2008a, 2021）的批评，理由是它忽视了拉齐自己的快乐理论。按这一理论——它明显以《蒂迈欧篇》为据——快乐只能作为消除某种有害状态之过程的结果而被享有。例如，喝水之所以令人愉快，是因为它消除了口渴。按这种快乐观，正如柏拉图本人指出的，快乐主义是一场企图在零和博弈中取胜的尝试：你只能在受了痛苦、或至少受了损害的范围内拥有快乐。（并非所有损害都被感受为痛苦，正如并非所有恢复都被感受为快乐，因为只有快速的变化才被注意到。）此外，拉齐自己在《对盖伦的质疑》中（DG: §7.7）说快乐 ** 不是 ** 本身值得追求的善——这是对伊壁鸠鲁主义所采纳的那类快乐主义的直接拒斥。

en: On this latter reading, much of al-Rāzī’s advice for readers focuses on helping non-philosophers work towards a moderate lifestyle, which will prepare them for the more serious and important undertaking of adopting a “philosophical way of life” that will ultimately lead to liberation from the body. Al-Rāzī himself seems to accept this distinction between “pre-philosophical” and “philosophical” ethics (Druart 1997, Adamson 2016)[^adamson-2016][^druart-1997], for example in the aforementioned passage about the glutton who loves dates. Al-Rāzī says he threatened the man with stomach aches and illness because
zh: 按后一种解读，拉齐给读者的建议大多聚焦于帮助非哲学家走向一种节制的生活方式，这将为他们做更严肃、更重要的准备——采纳一种“哲学的生活方式”，它最终导向从身体中的解脱。拉齐本人似乎接受“前哲学的”与“哲学的”伦理之分（Druart 1997, Adamson 2016）[^adamson-2016][^druart-1997]，例如在前述那个嗜食椰枣的饕餮者的段落里。拉齐说他以胃痛与疾病警告那个人，是因为

en: this and other such remarks are of more benefit to someone who has not engaged in philosophical training than proofs built on philosophical principles.
zh: 这类话以及其他类似的话，对尚未接受哲学训练的人，比建立在哲学原理之上的证明更有益处。

en: As for the truly philosophical life, it resides in the Platonic ideal of imitating God (*Theaetetus* 176b), realized through the pursuit of wisdom and justice towards all living things. In a remarkable passage of the *Philosophical Way of Life*, al-Rāzī stresses the importance of not mistreating beasts of burden and other non-rational animals (Adamson 2012)[^adamson-2012]. This would explain the “upper limit” placed on the pursuit of justice: that limit does not derive from the need to maximize pleasure and minimize pain, but from the injunction to avoid “displeasing God” by engaging in injustice.
zh: 至于真正哲学的生活，它在于柏拉图的效仿上帝之理想（《泰阿泰德》176b），通过追求智慧与对一切有生之物的正义来实现。《哲学的生活方式》中有一段引人注目的文字，拉齐强调不可虐待驮兽与其他无理性的动物（Adamson 2012）[^adamson-2012]。这可以解释施加于正义追求的“上限”：那个界限并非来自最大化快乐、最小化痛苦的需要，而是来自不可因行不义而“令上帝不悦”的诫命。

en: In more recent publications this interpretive dispute seems to be moving towards agreement. Goodman (2015) now concedes that al-Rāzī, unlike Epicurus, does not make pleasure the highest good and sole criterion in ethics. He does however adopt a therapeutic approach to ethics, which is characteristic of Epicureanism, as of course is the advice to avoid things that bring pain than pleasure all things considered. Adamson accepts this (2021: 6), but suggests that the resonances with Epicureanism may rather reflect a more general reception of Hellenistic ethics by al-Rāzī, again through the intermediary of Galen (see also Bar-Asher 1989)[^bar-asher-1989].
zh: 在晚近的出版物中，这一诠释之争似乎正走向一致。Goodman（2015）现在承认：拉齐不同于伊壁鸠鲁，并不把快乐当作最高的善与伦理的唯一判准。不过他确实采纳了一种治疗性的伦理进路，这是伊壁鸠鲁主义的特征——当然，“避开综合考量下带来的痛苦多于快乐的东西”这一建议亦然。Adamson 接受了这一点（2021: 6），但提出：与伊壁鸠鲁主义的这些共鸣，也许更多反映的是拉齐经由盖伦的中介对希腊化伦理的一般接受（另见 Bar-Asher 1989）[^bar-asher-1989]。

en: 4. Medicine and the *Doubts*
zh: 4 医学与《质疑》

en: As yet, al-Rāzī’s extensive medical corpus has barely been explored with a view to its philosophical significance. An account of the human body and its primary organs in the *Spiritual Life*—here ascribed to Plato—echoes what he says on this topic in medical works (Adamson 2021: 57–58)[^adamson-2021]. His view, following both Galen and the *Timaeus*, is that humans have three general powers or faculties (*quwan*), the rational, animal or irascible, and vegetative or desiderative, associated respectively with the brain, heart, and liver. The rational soul is not really seated in the brain, as the other two faculties are seated in their organs; it uses the brain only as an instrument. In medical contexts al-Rāzī makes the same three organs to be the seats of these powers, albeit that the power in the brain is instead called “psychic (*nafsānī*)”, perhaps to acknowledge the fact that its powers of voluntary self-motion and sensation also belong to irrational animals.
zh: 迄今，拉齐庞大的医学著作几乎还未被从哲学意义的角度加以开掘。《精神医学》中有一段对人身及其主要器官的描述——在那里归于柏拉图——与他在医学著作中就这一话题所说的一致（Adamson 2021: 57–58）[^adamson-2021]。他的看法——跟随盖伦与《蒂迈欧篇》——是人拥有三种总的力量或官能（*quwan*）：理性的、动物性的或易怒的、植物性的或欲望的，分别与脑、心、肝相联。理性灵魂并不真正驻于脑中（如另两种官能驻于其器官那样）；它只是把脑用作工具。在医学语境中，拉齐让同样这三个器官作为这些力量的座位，只是脑中的力量改称“心灵的（*nafsānī*）”——或许是承认这一点：其自主自运与感觉的力量也为无理性的动物所具有。

en: Al-Rāzī’s views on medical epistemology are also Galenic, and presuppose that the best doctor should understand the human body at a theoretical level while also drawing on a wealth of experience (Pormann 2008)[^pormann-2008]. This provides a methodological context for understanding the aforementioned *Comprehensive Book*, which as mentioned collects book-learning on medical theory, but uses al-Rāzī’s own empirical observations to confirm or disconfirm those theories.
zh: 拉齐的医学认识论观点也是盖伦式的，并预设：最好的医生应当既在理论层面理解人身，又倚重丰富的经验（Pormann 2008）[^pormann-2008]。这为理解前面提到的《集成》提供了方法论语境：如前所述，它汇集关于医学理论的书本知识，但用拉齐自己的经验观察来确证或否证那些理论。

en: But the most rewarding medical text for philosophical readers is *Doubts about Galen.* Or rather, it should be said that this work deals with a range of philosophical, as well as medical, issues, including the relation between soul and body, vision, atomism, and pleasure (see the ample introduction by Koetschet in al-Rāzī, DG). Regarding the first of these issues, al-Rāzī criticizes Galen for suggesting that the soul is entirely dependent on bodily states or “temperament”, that is, the mixture of the body’s constituents. As in the *Spiritual Medicine*, he defends Plato’s idea that the rational part of the soul only uses the brain as an “instrument (*āla*)”, and that injury to the brain impedes rational function only in the way that damage to a flute would make it harder for the flute player to perform (al-Rāzī, DG: §21.4). When it comes to vision, al-Rāzī strikes a less Platonist note, since he rejects Galen’s “extramissionist” theory, which is in part inspired by Plato’s *Timaeus*. According to Galen, spirit (*pneuma*) is sent forth from the eyes and transforms air, making it into an instrument for contacting the visual object (Ierodiakonou 2014)[^ierodiakonou-2014]. Instead, al-Rāzī defends the view that incorporeal images are sent from the seen object and arrive at the eye (Koetschet 2017a)[^koetschet-2017a].
zh: 对哲学读者而言最有回报的医学文本是《对盖伦的质疑》。或者说得更准确些：应当说这部著作处理一系列哲学的（以及医学的）问题，包括灵魂与身体的关系、视觉、原子论与快乐（见 Koetschet 在 al-Rāzī, DG 中的充分导言）。关于其中第一个问题，拉齐批评盖伦暗示灵魂完全依赖于身体状态或“气质”（temperament），即身体诸成分的混合。与《精神医学》一样，他捍卫柏拉图的观念：灵魂的理性部分只把脑用作“工具（*āla*）”，脑的损伤妨碍理性功能，正如长笛的损坏会使吹笛者更难演奏（al-Rāzī, DG: §21.4）。至于视觉，拉齐的调子不那么柏拉图主义，因为他拒绝了盖伦的“外射说”——它在一定程度上受柏拉图《蒂迈欧篇》启发。按盖伦的说法，精气（*pneuma*）从眼中发出并改变空气，使之成为接触视觉对象的工具（Ierodiakonou 2014）[^ierodiakonou-2014]。拉齐则捍卫另一种观点：无形的影像从被看见的对象发出，抵达眼睛（Koetschet 2017a）[^koetschet-2017a]。

en: One of the more elaborate philosophical discussions in the *Doubts about Galen* comes early in the work, and is devoted to the eternity of the world (this section is translated in PWL). Al-Rāzī here takes issue with Galen’s suggestion that empirical observation shows that the world was not created after not existing. Galen’s idea, based on a passage in Aristotle (*On the Heavens* 1.3, 270b11–16), is that the universe seems to be unchanging in its general features. If it is unchanging then it is not liable to corruption, and what is incorruptible is also ungenerable. Thus the universe has always existed, and always will. Al-Rāzī has little difficulty poking holes in this argument: he points out that the universe could be unchanging for a long time, and then be destroyed all at once, like a glass being smashed or a building collapsing when previously solid ground under it gives way (al-Rāzī, DG: §2.3). Furthermore, the incorruptibility of the universe would not be guaranteed by its lacking a natural tendency to decay. One also needs to rule out that there is some external cause that could destroy it (al-Rāzī, DG: §2.5). As often in the *Doubts*, al-Rāzī is here not trying to show that Galen’s conclusion is wrong—though in this case, we know that he thinks it is wrong—but that the argument offered for the conclusion is not sufficient. Ironically, this seems to be in accord with Galen’s own original intention. Galen’s argument is taken from his *On Demonstration* and was actually offered as an example of a proof that is *not* demonstrative (Koetschet 2015)[^koetschet-2015]. Al-Rāzī is either being remarkably contentious, or has lost sight of the context of the argument: he even accuses Galen of being inconsistent, as he elsewhere states that it cannot be proven whether or not the universe is eternal.
zh: 《对盖伦的质疑》中较精致的哲学讨论之一出现在全书靠前处，专门讨论世界的永恒（此节有英译，见 PWL）。拉齐在此就盖伦的提议提出异议：经验观察表明世界并非在不存在之后被创造。盖伦的想法（依据亚里士多德《论天》1.3, 270b11–16 的一段）是：宇宙在其一般特征上似乎是不变的。如果它不变，它就不会败坏；而不败坏者也不被生成。于是宇宙一直存在，并将永远存在。拉齐毫不费力地戳穿了这一论证：他指出，宇宙可以长时间不变，然后一瞬间被毁灭——就像一只玻璃杯被砸碎，或一座建筑因其下先前坚实的地面塌陷而倒塌（al-Rāzī, DG: §2.3）。此外，宇宙之不败坏并不能由其缺乏败坏的自然倾向来保证。人们还须排除存在某种能毁灭它的外部原因（al-Rāzī, DG: §2.5）。正如在《质疑》中常见的那样，拉齐在此并非要表明盖伦的结论错了——虽然在这个案例中，我们知道他认为它是错的——而是要表明为该结论提供的论证并不充分。讽刺的是，这似乎与盖伦本人的原意相合：盖伦的论证取自其《论证明》，实际上是被当作一个 ** 非 ** 证明性证明的例子给出的（Koetschet 2015）[^koetschet-2015]。拉齐要么异常好斗，要么忽略了论证的语境：他甚至指责盖伦自相矛盾，因为盖伦在别处说宇宙是否永恒是无法证明的。

en: 5. Religion and Prophecy
zh: 5 宗教与预言

en: If the five eternal theory was considered problematic by contemporaries and later authors, al-Rāzī’s views on religion were considered utterly outrageous and heretical. In his *Proofs of Prophecy*, Abū Ḥātim selectively quotes and paraphrases from a work by al-Rāzī on this topic, and presents him as having flatly denied the validity of prophetic revelation. Accepting this evidence as more or less reliable, some modern-day scholars have celebrated al-Rāzī as a “freethinker” comparable with such daringly unorthodox thinkers as Ibn al-Rāwandī (Urvoy 1996, Stroumsa 1999)[^stroumsa-1999][^urvoy-1996], or even as having had pagan sympathies (Vallat 2015a, 2015b, 2016)[^vallat-2015a]. Against this, Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī quotes our al-Rāzī as having offered interpretations of the Qurʾān, which were designed to show that this revelatory text and indeed the whole history of prophecy was in agreement with his own philosophy (this evidence is presented and discussed in Rashed 2000, 2008)[^rashed-2000]. The bio-bibliographical tradition is also ambiguous in its evidence. For instance al-Bīrūnī, who clearly admired al-Rāzī, admits that he made foolish and obstinate remarks about religion and prophecy. But another broadly favorable witness, Ibn Abī Uṣaybiʿa, says that a supposed work attacking religion was perhaps written by “malicious enemies of al-Rāzī and ascribed to him” (for references, see Adamson 2021: 11)[^adamson-2021].
zh: 如果说五大永恒理论在同代与后世作者看来是有问题的，那么拉齐关于宗教的观点则被认为是大逆不道、离经叛道的。在其《预言的证明》中，阿布·哈蒂姆有选择地引用与转述拉齐就此主题的一部著作，把他呈现为断然否认预言启示之有效性的人。接受这一材料或多或少可靠的一些现代学者，把拉齐称颂为与伊本·拉万迪这类大胆离经叛道的思想家比肩的“自由思想者”（Urvoy 1996, Stroumsa 1999）[^stroumsa-1999][^urvoy-1996]，甚至认为他怀有异教同情（Vallat 2015a, 2015b, 2016）[^vallat-2015a]。与此相对，法赫尔丁·拉齐则引用我们的拉齐，说他曾对《古兰经》提出诠释，旨在表明这部启示文本乃至整个预言史都与拉齐自己的哲学相合（这一材料由 Rashed 2000, 2008 呈现并讨论）[^rashed-2000]。生平-书目传统的证据同样是含混的。例如，明确欣赏拉齐的比鲁尼承认，他对宗教与预言发表过愚蠢而顽固的言论。但另一位大体友善的见证者伊本·艾比·乌赛比阿则说，一部据称攻击宗教的著作或许是“拉齐的恶毒敌人所写并托名于他”的（参考出处见 Adamson 2021: 11）[^adamson-2021]。

en: The most ample, if not necessarily trustworthy, evidence is found in Abū Ḥātim. He says that in face-to-face debate, al-Rāzī argued against prophecy on the grounds that it would be unjust to single out only some people for knowledge that is useful by everyone. Furthermore, appointing only a certain few as religious leaders (*imām*s) would lead to dissension between their followers (Abū Ḥātim, AHR: 1). Followers of religious law are guilty of the cardinal intellectual sin of the Islamic world, *taqlīd*, which means uncritically adopting beliefs on the basis of authority (AHR: 24). Instead, al-Rāzī argues, God gives reason (*ʿaql*) to everyone, and in this respect everyone is created equal, able to determine for themselves what goals they should be pursuing. Furthermore, Abū Ḥātim tells us about a range of more specific religious teachings rejected by al-Rāzī in his book against prophecy, such as anthropomorphic descriptions of God and the possibility of miracles, including the inimitability of the Qurʾān (*iʿjāz*).
zh: 最充分——即使未必最可信——的证据见于阿布·哈蒂姆。他说在面对面辩论中，拉齐反对预言的理由是：只把对人人有用的知识拣选给某些人是不义的。此外，只任命少数几个人为宗教领袖（*imām*，伊玛目）会在其追随者之间造成分裂（Abū Ḥātim, AHR: 1）。遵守宗教律法的人犯了伊斯兰世界中头号的理智罪过：因袭（*taqlīd*），即不加批判地依据权威采纳信念（AHR: 24）。拉齐论证说，毋宁说上帝把理性（*ʿaql*）赐予每个人，在这方面人人被造平等，能够自己决定应当追求什么目标。此外，阿布·哈蒂姆告诉我们，拉齐在其反预言的书中拒绝了更多具体的宗教教导，如对上帝的拟人化描述、奇迹的可能性，包括《古兰经》的不可模仿性（*iʿjāz*）。

en: In several respects this teaching on prophecy fits well with what we know of al-Rāzī’s philosophy more generally. It invokes the idea that reason is given to the soul as a gift from God, something confirmed in other sources and suggested at the beginning of al-Rāzī’s *Spiritual Medicine*. Furthermore, Abū Ḥātim has al-Rāzī arguing that God would not send prophets because this is an unreasonable and overly difficult way to achieve His goals (Abū Ḥātim, AHR: 1; 131–2). Why not just give everyone the ability to figure things out for themselves? This same premise that God only proceeds in the most rational way is also important in his theodicy as we know it from other sources, as seen above. Furthermore the critique of *taqlīd*, while admittedly commonplace, does sound like it could come from al-Rāzī: his irreverent approach to Galen bears witness to a similar independence of mind, albeit in a very different context.
zh: 在若干方面，这一关于预言的教导与我们所知的拉齐哲学的总体面貌相当合拍。它诉诸“理性是上帝赐予灵魂的礼物”这一观念——这一点得到其他材料的证实，并见于《精神医学》的开头。此外，阿布·哈蒂姆笔下的拉齐论证说：上帝不会派遣先知，因为这是实现其目标的一种不合理且过于艰难的方式（Abū Ḥātim, AHR: 1; 131–2）。为什么不直接让每个人都有能力自己弄明白呢？上帝只以最合理的方式行事——这同一个前提，如前所见，在他的神义论中同样重要。此外，对因袭的批评虽然确实司空见惯，但听起来的确像是出自拉齐之口：他对盖伦的放肆态度见证了类似的独立心智，尽管语境迥异。

en: On the other hand, the evidence presented by Fakhr al-Dīn casts serious doubt on the notion that al-Rāzī was openly hostile to the Islamic revelation. And this is backed up by evidence internal to al-Rāzī’s own surviving works, for instance acknowledgment of the preeminent value of “books sent by God” in *Doubts about Galen* (al-Rāzī, DG: §2.1). At a minimum it seems clear that al-Rāzī was a forthright rationalist, who believed that the truth of a revelatory text would necessarily accord with the truth discoverable by human reason. But that position would not be so remarkable: it is shared from other philosophers of the Islamic world, from al-Kindī to al-Fārābī to Ibn Rushd. The question is whether al-Rāzī went further and insisted that revelation is useless, or even counterproductive, as claimed by Abū Ḥātim.
zh: 另一方面，法赫尔丁提供的证据使“拉齐公开敌视伊斯兰启示”的看法大为可疑。这又得到拉齐自己传世著作中的内证支持，例如《对盖伦的质疑》中承认“上帝降示的诸书”具有卓越价值（al-Rāzī, DG: §2.1）。至少可以清楚地看到：拉齐是一位坦率的理性主义者，他相信启示性文本的真理必然与人类理性可发现的真理相合。但这一立场并不那么惊人：从铿迪到法拉比再到伊本·鲁世德，伊斯兰世界的其他哲学家都持有它。问题是拉齐是否走得更远，坚称启示无用、甚至适得其反——如阿布·哈蒂姆所主张的那样。

en: Recent material brought to light by Philippe Vallat (2015a, 2015b, 2016) could confirm this interpretation. It would show that al-Rāzī said in debate with a theologian named Abū Qāsim al-Balkhī, also called al-Kaʿbī, that “prophets are unnecessary, because we have reason which suffices, assuming that prophecy is in accordance with reason” (on al-Kaʿbī in general see El Omari 2016; and on their debate Rashed 2000, Shihadeh 2006: 103)[^rashed-2000][^shihadeh-2006]. It has however been argued that Vallat’s new evidence cannot convincingly be linked to the debate between al-Kaʿbī and al-Rāzī, who is never named in these texts (Adamson 2021: 148–151)[^adamson-2021]. A different approach would be to read Abū Ḥātim as having distorted al-Rāzī’s position, which may have been a more targeted attack on schismatic and controversialist groups including the Ismāʿīlī branch of Islam to which Abū Ḥātim belonged. Ismāʿīlism is characterized by its insistence on the need for a religious leader or *imām* to guide the faithful to a true understanding of Islam. It may have been this doctrine, and not prophecy more generally, that al-Rāzī attacked, as a signal example of the dangers of *taqlīd* (Mohaghegh 1970: 160–1; Adamson 2021: 147)[^adamson-2021][^mohaghegh-1970]. A more recent compromise interpretation suggests that al-Rāzī was a rationalist, but one who saw a need for deference to prophets because of their unique expertise on important matters, especially in matters of ethics (Güngür 2023).
zh: Philippe Vallat（2015a, 2015b, 2016）最近揭示的材料可以证实后一种解读。它将表明拉齐在与一位名为阿布·卡西姆·巴尔赫（又称凯比）的神学家的辩论中说过：“先知是不必要的，因为我们拥有足敷使用的理性——假定预言与理性相合”（关于凯比的一般研究见 El Omari 2016；关于他们的辩论见 Rashed 2000, Shihadeh 2006: 103）[^rashed-2000][^shihadeh-2006]。然而，也有人论证：瓦拉的新材料无法令人信服地与凯比和拉齐之间的辩论挂勾，因为拉齐在这些文本中从未被点名（Adamson 2021: 148–151）[^adamson-2021]。另一种解读进路，是把阿布·哈蒂姆读作扭曲了拉齐的立场——后者或许是对分裂教派与好辩集团的更有针对性的攻击，其中包括阿布·哈蒂姆所属的伊斯兰教伊斯玛仪支派。伊斯玛仪派的特点是坚持需要一位宗教领袖或伊玛目来引导信众正确理解伊斯兰。拉齐攻击的或许正是这一教义（而非更一般的预言），视之为因袭之危险的一个标志性例证（Mohaghegh 1970: 160–1; Adamson 2021: 147）[^adamson-2021][^mohaghegh-1970]。较晚近的一种折中解读则认为：拉齐是一位理性主义者，但认为有必要尊重先知，因为他们在重要事项上有独特的专长，尤其是在伦理事务上（Güngör 2023）。

en: 6. Legacy
zh: 6 身后影响

en: Whatever the case, there is no doubt that the Ismāʿīlīs were especially hostile to al-Rāzī. Alongside Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī and the aforementioned Naṣīr-e Khosraw, who was also an Ismāʿīlī, one may mention another representative of this group named Ḥamīd al-Dīn al-Kirmānī (d. after 1020), who attacked al-Rāzī’s ethical teachings (Ḥamīd al-Dīn al-Kirmānī, see HDK in bibliography). This is not to say that only Ismāʿīlī authors are critical of al-Rāzī, though. Another opponent, who polemicizes against al-Rāzī’s cosmology and apparent belief in the possibility of transmigration (al-Rāzī, RF: 174), is the Andalusian jurist and philosopher Ibn Ḥazm. Also in the Western Islamic world, Maimonides includes a diatribe against the Razian theodicy in his *Guide for the Perplexed* (GP: §3.12). Though Ibn Ḥazm associates other thinkers with al-Rāzī’s teachings (al-Rāzī, RF: 170 and 174) it does not seem that his daring ideas gained much traction among later philosophers. Perhaps the most productive engagement with the five eternal theory is found in Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī. He gives a fair hearing to al-Rāzī’s account of place and time, and adopts a similar view on the question of time in particular (Adamson and Lammer 2020)[^adamson-2020].
zh: 无论如何，毫无疑问，伊斯玛仪派对拉齐尤其敌视。除阿布·哈蒂姆·拉齐与前面提到的纳赛尔·霍斯鲁（他也是伊斯玛仪派）之外，还可以提到该集团的另一位代表：哈米德丁·基尔曼尼（卒于 1020 年之后），他攻击拉齐的伦理教导（哈米德丁·基尔曼尼，见文献 HDK）。不过这并不是说只有伊斯玛仪派作者批评拉齐。另一位论敌是安达卢西亚的教法学家兼哲学家伊本·哈兹姆，他抨击拉齐的宇宙论及其表面上的转世之可能性信念（al-Rāzī, RF: 174）。同样在伊斯兰西部世界，迈蒙尼德在《迷途指津》收入了对拉齐式神义论的一段抨击（GP: §3.12）。虽然伊本·哈兹姆把其他思想家与拉齐的教导相联（al-Rāzī, RF: 170 and 174），拉齐那些大胆的想法在后世哲学家中间似乎并未获得多少追随。对五大永恒理论最富成果的回应，或许见于法赫尔丁·拉齐。他给了拉齐关于处所与时间的说明一场公正的听证，并在时间问题上采纳了类似的观点（Adamson and Lammer 2020）[^adamson-2020]。

en: In his primary vocation of medicine, too, al-Rāzī had his critics, including Ibn Sīnā, his only rival for the title of most influential figure in the Islamic medical tradition. In an epistolary exchange with al-Bīrūnī, Ibn Sīnā says that al-Rāzī overreached his competence in both philosophy and medicine (“he exceeded his abilities when lancing abscesses and examining urine and feces”, quoted at al-Rāzī, RF: 290). Al-Rāzī’s project in *Doubts* was also deemed presumptuous by later medical writers, who composed refutations of the work. Nonetheless, al-Rāzī’s works were widely consulted by doctors in the Islamic world, and he had a wide diffusion in the Latin speaking world under the name “Rhazes”. This began in the medieval period and persisted through the Renaissance, with sixty-seven printed editions of his works before 1700 (Hasse 2016: 8)[^hasse-2016]. No less an authority than Vesalius edited an older translation of al-Rāzī’s *Book for al-Manṣūr*, and al-Rāzī’s medical writings were on the teaching syllabus at Bologna, the most important university in Europe for medical training (Siriasi 1990: 131 and 178)[^siriasi-1990]. The independent-minded Girolamo Cardano, who in personality and diversity of interests was in some ways the heir of Galen and al-Rāzī, praised the latter as one of several doctors from the Islamic world who had improved upon Galenic medicine through empirical observation (*experimentum*) (Siriasi 1997: 60)[^siriasi-1997]. More recently, al-Rāzī has been praised for his innovative approach and for breakthroughs in the history of medicine, for example by investigating differential diagnosis (Iskandar 1962)[^iskandar-1962] and using a control group to test the efficacy of a drug (Pormann 2008)[^pormann-2008]. Thus al-Rāzī the doctor has had a more illustrious posthumous career than al-Rāzī the philosopher.
zh: 在他的第一职业医学领域，拉齐同样有批评者，包括伊本·西那——他在“伊斯兰医学传统中最有影响的人物”这一头衔上的唯一对手。在与比鲁尼的书信往来中，伊本·西那说拉齐在哲学与医学两方面都逾越了自己的胜任范围（“他在放脓与验尿验便时逞能”，转引自 al-Rāzī, RF: 290）。拉齐在《质疑》中的工程也被后世医学作者视为僭妄，他们撰文驳斥该书。尽管如此，拉齐的著作被伊斯兰世界的医生广泛查阅，而他也以“拉齐斯”（Rhazes）之名在拉丁语世界广泛流传。这始于中世纪，延续到文艺复兴：1700 年前其著作有 67 个印本（Hasse 2016: 8）[^hasse-2016]。维萨里这样的大权威也编辑过拉齐《献给曼苏尔的书》的一个较早译本；拉齐的医学著作被列入博洛尼亚——欧洲最重要的医学培养重镇——的教学大纲（Siriasi 1990: 131 and 178）[^siriasi-1990]。特立独行的吉罗拉莫·卡尔达诺——在个性与兴趣之广博上，他某种意义上是盖伦与拉齐的继承者——称赞拉齐是几位凭借经验观察（*experimentum*）改进了盖伦医学的伊斯兰世界医生之一（Siriasi 1997: 60）[^siriasi-1997]。晚近以来，拉齐因其创新进路与其在医学史上的突破受到称颂，例如考察鉴别诊断（Iskandar 1962）[^iskandar-1962]、以及使用对照组检验药物疗效（Pormann 2008）[^pormann-2008]。因此，作为医生的拉齐，其身后声名比作为哲学家的拉齐更为显赫。

en: Academic Freedom
zh: 学术自由 Academic Freedom (Jacob T. Levy)

en: **First published Sat Oct 17, 2026**

The organizational form that came to be called “universities” developed over the course of the 11ᵗʰ–13ᵗʰ centuries in western Europe. From an early date they differed from other forms of educational institutions such as cathedral schools by virtue of their corporate self-governance, a degree of independence from both the Catholic Church and political authorities. That degree varied and was always contested, but the normative commitment to it (and willingness to defend it) shaped what has become one of the longest-lasting of medieval European institutions.
zh: 后来被称为“大学”的那种组织形式，于 11 至 13 世纪间在西欧逐渐成形。早在早期，它们就凭其法团式的自我治理——一种既独立于天主教会、又独立于政治权威的自主程度——而有别于主教座堂学校等其他教育机构形式。这种自主的程度时有起伏、始终受到争夺，但对它的规范性承诺（以及捍卫它的意愿）塑造了这一中世纪欧洲最悠久的制度之一。

en: “Academic freedom” as a system of professional norms, explicit commitments, and sometimes legal rights draws on that tradition, but is much newer, dating only to the 19ᵗʰ century in Germany and the 20ᵗʰ century in the influential articulation it found in the United States. The idea resembles in some respects liberal rights such as freedom of speech, but it was not derived from those rights. It is acknowledged and defined in some international charters and in the domestic constitutional law of some countries, but the main development of the idea has been extralegal. It is variously thought to be essentially a corporate right of universities, or disciplines, or units within universities; a guild-like privilege of the professoriate; a system of professional ethics for internal university governance; or a special kind of individual human right. Its grounding is nearly as contested. This conceptual and normative muddiness belies a substantial, albeit incomplete, consensus on core practices and commitments.
zh: “学术自由”作为一套职业规范、明确承诺、有时还有法律权利的体系，承续了这一传统，但要新得多：它始于十九世纪的德国，二十世纪在美国获得了影响深远的表述。这一观念在某些方面与言论自由等自由权利相似，却并非从那些权利中推导而来。它在一些国际宪章与一些国家的国内宪法中被承认和界定，但这一观念的主要发展是在法律之外。人们或认为它本质上是大学、或学科、或大学内部单位的法团性权利；或认为它是教授群体的行会式特权；或认为它是大学内部治理的一套职业伦理；或认为它是一种特殊类型的个人人权。其根据同样充满争议。这种概念与规范上的含混，掩盖着一个实质性的——尽管并不完整的——关于核心实践与承诺的共识。

en: Broadly speaking, that consensus includes rights of individual scholars to research, to study, and to teach within universities, according to their intellectual and professional judgment, subject to professional and disciplinary standards about method but not subject to orthodoxy as to conclusions. It concomitantly includes the autonomy of academic units— universities as such, but also larger scholarly communities such as disciplines, and smaller units such as departments or faculties— to govern themselves in setting such standards. Non-orthodoxy and scholarly associational self-governance will be recurring themes of the entry.
zh: 大体而言，这一共识包括：学者个人在大学之内按其学术与职业判断进行研究、学习与教学的权利，受关于方法的职业与学科标准的约束，但不受关于结论的正统之约束。与之相伴的是学术单位的自主性——大学本身，也包括学科等更大的学术共同体，以及系或学部等更小的单位——在设定这些标准上的自我治理。非正统与学术共同体的自我治理，将是本词条反复出现的主题。

en: Academic freedom is thus interesting as a hybrid concept: corporate and individual, derived inductively from institutional practice but normatively systematized, having something of the character of internal professional ethics and something of the character of general rights-claims.
zh: 因此，学术自由作为一个混合概念而引人兴味：它既是法团的又是个人的，从制度实践中归纳而来却又被规范性地系统化，既有内部职业伦理的品格，又有一般权利主张的品格。

en: It is moreover of interest *to philosophers*, and not only because professional philosophers today are generally academics employed in universities*.* The broad freedom of inquiry that partly inspires academic freedom is the kind of ideal we retrospectively attribute to the Socratic foundations of western philosophy. With less anachronism and more historical certainty, we can say that philosophers were among the key figures who developed and articulated the university-centered idea of academic freedom: Wilhelm von Humboldt in the 19ᵗʰ century, John Dewey in the 20ᵗʰ. In recent decades philosophers have played a less central role in thinking about it, with scholars in the professional disciplines of law and education more often taking the lead. There are, however, signs of renewed philosophical interest in the last decade (Lackey ed. 2018a)[^lackey-2018a], due in part to an upsurge in violations of, challenges to, and confusion about academic freedom and its worth.
zh: 而且，它 ** 对哲学家而言 ** 值得关心，这还不只是因为今天的职业哲学家一般是在大学受雇的学人。部分地激发学术自由的那种宽泛的探究自由，正是我们回溯性地归于西方哲学之苏格拉底根基的那类理想。少一些时代错置、多一些历史确定性地说，哲学家正是发展与阐明以大学为中心的学术自由观念的关键人物：十九世纪的威廉·冯·洪堡，二十世纪的杜威。近几十年来，哲学家在思考这一问题时的角色不再居于中心，更多时候是法律与教育学这两个职业学科的学者领风气之先。不过，过去十年已有哲学兴趣回暖的迹象（Lackey 编 2018a）[^lackey-2018a]，部分原因是学术自由及其价值遭到的侵犯、挑战与混淆出现了激增。

en: 1. History
zh: 1 历史

en: Beginning with the Universities of Bologna (1088 CE), Oxford (1096), and Paris (1150)— these are conventional dates for what were in all cases gradual institutional developments (Rashdall 1895)[^rashdall-1895]— and with a rapid proliferation thereafter, medieval European scholars clustered together in associations that became increasingly formal and corporate. They began as self-reinforcing local clusters: a few expert instructors drawing students to a city, the paying clientele of students in turn creating demand that encouraged instructors. Formalization on the contemporaneously developing guild model of masters and apprentices paid benefits: the ability to negotiate terms with host cities, but also the ability to confer widely-legible credentials by admitting a newly trained scholar as a master in turn.
zh: 从博洛尼亚大学（公元 1088 年）、牛津（1096 年）与巴黎（1150 年）开始——这些是本皆为渐次制度演进的机构的惯用纪年（Rashdall 1895）[^rashdall-1895]——中世纪欧洲的学者聚为一个个日益正式、日益法团化的行会。此后迅速增殖。它们起初是自我强化的地方性集群：少数博学的教师把学生吸引到一座城市，付费的学生群体反过来制造需求、又鼓励了教师。按当时正在成型的师徒行会模式加以形式化，收益可观：既可同东道城市谈判条件，又可通过接纳新近学成的学者为师，授予广受承认的资历。

en: By the 1150s, the reality of the scholarly community at Bologna was clear enough to be recognized by a grant of imperial privilege, the *Authentica Habita* of Holy Roman Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, subsequently inserted into the *Corpus Iuris Civile* as a general provision of the Roman civil law. Some of the protected rights reflected existing, if contested, practice, including the always-controversial right for scholars to be tried by internal tribunals or else clerical ones rather than local civil courts. But also among the protected privileges were, crucially, freedom of movement, the right of scholars not to be molested, taxed, or to have their goods seized in travelling to and from Bologna. The norm was subsequently generalized to scholars at other universities as well.
zh: 到 1150 年代，博洛尼亚学术共同体的实态已清楚到足以被一纸帝国特权所承认，即神圣罗马皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的 *Authentica Habita*，该敕令随后作为罗马民法的一般条款被编入《民法大全》。受保护的权利中有些反映的是既有（虽有争议）的实践，包括始终争议不断的、学者应由内部法庭或教会法庭而非地方世俗法庭审判的权利。但受保护的特权中至关重要的还有迁徙自由：学者往来博洛尼亚途中不受骚扰、不被征税、财物不被扣押的权利。这一规范随后被推广到其他大学的学者。

en: First Bologna and then other universities drew students from across Latin Catholic Europe. Bologna was for centuries the preeminent institution for education in the recovered Roman civil law as well as in canon law, and that shared training in turn helped to spread civil law as legal practice far and wide. Paris came to hold a similar status in the study of theology, providing a path to advancement in clerical offices for students from across the Catholic world. The evolution of their institutional forms was stamped by the fact that they brought many foreigners into the cities where they were located. Indeed the English and French word *nation* derives from a kind of corporate organization of students by countries of origin within universities, from the Latin *natio* to be born. At Bologna the distinction was simply between Italians and non-Italians, and at Oxford northerners and southerners, but most famously at Paris, French, Normans, Picards, English, and later Germans. But this cosmopolitan fact was vulnerable to the complex political and jurisdictional patchwork of medieval Europe; travel over long distances involved passing through the territories of many different rulers. The norm of free travel extended by the *Authentica Habita* was thus an important piece of protection of university scholars *qua* scholars.
zh: 先是博洛尼亚、继而其他大学，从拉丁天主教欧洲各地招纳学生。数百年间，博洛尼亚是复兴的罗马民法与教会法教育的最高学府，这种共同的训练反过来又把民法的法律实践撒播四方。巴黎则在神学研究中获得了类似地位，为天主教世界的学生提供教职晋升之阶。它们制度形态的演进，打上了“把许多外国人带入其所在城市”这一事实的烙印。事实上，英语与法语的 *nation*（民族）一词，正源自大学内按生源地组织学生的那种法团组织，来自拉丁语 *natio*（出生）。在博洛尼亚，区分只是意大利人与非意大利人；在牛津是北方人与南方人；最著名的是在巴黎：法兰西人、诺曼人、皮卡第人、英格兰人，以及后来的德意志人。但这一世界主义的事实，在中世纪欧洲复杂的政治与司法拼图中是脆弱的：长途旅行要经过许多不同统治者的领地。*Authentica Habita* 所确立的自由旅行规范，因此是学者 *qua* 学者的一项重要保护。

en: In the 1200s, both popes and Emperors further confirmed the corporate autonomy and self-governance of universities, guaranteeing a degree of immunity from local civil or ecclesiastical interference. The institutions so recognized came to be known as *studia generale*, educational institutions marked by openness to non-local students; instruction in arts and in at least one of the higher faculties; and instruction in large part by qualified masters. *(Studium generale* is the closest medieval category to, in our sense, “university;” *universitas* was a generic term for encompassing corporate organizations in the civil law.) The practice of confirmation of autonomy was a deliberately imitative one. One way in which a school might elevate its claim to be a *studium* was with a papal bull incorporating by reference, in the standard example, the privileges and rights held by the University of Paris.
zh: 十三世纪，教皇与皇帝进一步确认了大学的法团自主与自我治理，保证了其在一定程度上免于地方世俗或教会的干涉。由此获得承认的机构后来被称为 *studium generale*（普通研习院）：以向非本地学生开放为标志的教育机构；教授文科及至少一门高级学部；且主要由有资历的教师授课。（*Studium generale* 是中世纪最接近我们所说“大学”的范畴；*universitas* 在民法中则是涵盖性法团组织的通称。）确认自主的实践是一种刻意的模仿：一所学校提升其 *studium* 地位的办法之一，就是靠教皇诏书援引——按标准例子——巴黎大学享有的特权与权利。

en: This spread of a *category* of institutions, *studia generalia*, made possible the rule of mutual recognition. The *ius ubique docendi* recognized the right of a master trained at one university to teach at another without being subject to further examination by the second. *Ius ubique docendi* evolved through a combination of customary deference to older universities and papal confirmation of the status of newer ones. Despite that partly-papal origin, once the norm was in place, it created a kind of self-governance of the academic profession as a whole. Scholarly qualifications were set, not by local political *or* religious authorities, but by the expectations of those who themselves had scholarly qualifications. The practice allowed for an institutionally decentralized and yet somehow unified body of scholars, and engendered a longstanding expectation that this scholarly community possessed self-governing authority beyond that held by an individual *studium.*
zh: *studia generalia* 这一 ** 机构范畴 ** 的扩散，使相互承认规则成为可能。*Ius ubique docendi*（随地任教权）承认在一所大学受训的教师有权到另一所大学任教，而无须再受后者的考核。 *Ius ubique docendi* 的演进，一半靠对老大学的习惯性尊崇，一半靠教皇对新大学地位的确认。尽管其起源部分地是教皇性的，这一规范一旦确立，便造就了一种学术职业总体的自我治理。学术资历的设定者，既非地方政治权威，亦非宗教权威，而是那些自身拥有学术资历者的预期。这一实践造就了一个在制度上去中心化、却在某种意义上统一的学者群体，并催生了一个悠久的预期：这一学术共同体拥有超越任何单个 *studium* 的自我治理权威。

en: These norms were not self-enforcing, and were far from universally respected. Over half a millennium of political and religious contestation, civil or religious authorities (or both) were often too powerful in practice to ignore. Those with authority over university governance were often allied to, or eager to curry favor with, some powerful faction. Detailing this history lies far outside the scope of this article. The point of interest is not that the norms were inviolable or universally adhered to, but that they existed at all, and persisted despite those political and religious conflicts, despite both the medieval power of the Church and the early modern power of the Crown.
zh: 这些规范并非自我执行，也远未受到普遍尊重。在五个多世纪的政治与宗教争夺中，世俗或宗教权威（或两者）在实际中往往强大得不容忽视。掌管大学治理的人常常依附于、或急于讨好某个强大的派系。详述这段历史远超本文范围。有趣的地方不在于这些规范不可侵犯或被普遍遵守，而在于它们居然存在，并且尽管有那些政治与宗教冲突——尽管有中世纪教会的权力与近代早期王冠的权力——依然延续下来。

en: These medieval and early modern practices — institutional self-governance for the *studium*, collective scholarly definition of expectations for the profession, and some kinds of immunity for the person of a scholar— encompassed a great deal of what we today call academic freedom, but hardly all of it. They carved out what is sometimes called *libertas scholastica* (Vozar 2025)[^vozar-2025], the liberty of the school, on analogy with the *libertas ecclesia*, the freedom of the corporate church from imperial and civil interference established by the outcome of the Investiture Controversy. Norms of *individual* scholarly autonomy, including (though not only) freedom within the university itself, drew on different traditions and were not clearly articulated until the 19ᵗʰ century.
zh: 这些中世纪与近代早期的实践——*studium* 的制度自我治理、由学术共同体集体界定职业预期、以及学者人身某些方面的豁免——涵盖了今天我们称为学术自由的很多东西，但远非全部。它们划出的是有时被称为 *libertas scholastica*（学府自由）的东西（Vozar 2025）[^vozar-2025]——类比于叙任权之争的结局所确立的 *libertas ecclesia*（教会自由），即作为法团的教会免于帝国与世俗干涉的自由。** 个人 ** 学术自主的规范——包括但不限于大学之内的自由——则取道于别的传统，直到十九世纪才被清楚地阐明。

en: *Libertas philosophandi*, the freedom of the individual philosopher to think and inquire free of the demands of orthodoxy, was an early modern idea, not a medieval one (Sutton 1953)[^sutton-1953]. Galileo appealed to such an idea a few times, and Spinoza introduced the phrase into the philosophical vocabulary (Sutton 1953)[^sutton-1953]. It was sometimes invoked in early modern universities, but was far from being universally embraced, and tellingly was *not* understood as a distinctive norm of university life (Vozar 2025)[^vozar-2025]. The ideal of unconstrained philosophical inquiry had ongoing appeal through the Enlightenment, but in the “Republic of Letters” rather than in universities as such.
zh: *Libertas philosophandi*（哲思自由），即哲学家个人摆脱正统要求而思考与探究的自由，是一个近代早期而非中世纪的观念（Sutton 1953）[^sutton-1953]。伽利略数次诉诸这一观念，斯宾诺莎则把这个词引入了哲学词汇（Sutton 1953）[^sutton-1953]。它在近代早期的大学中有时被援引，但远未受到普遍拥抱，而且意味深长的是，它并 ** 不 ** 被理解为大学生活的独特规范（Vozar 2025）[^vozar-2025]。不受约束的哲学探究这一理想，在启蒙时代持续保有魅力——但那是在“文人共和国”里，而不是在大学本身之中。

en: The liberal individualist philosopher and Prussian educational reformer Wilhelm von Humboldt did the key work of infusing a university with a commitment to individual scholarly liberty, a fusion that became academic freedom in the modern sense. In creating the new University of Berlin as an institution committed not only to teaching but also to original research, including in the liberal arts, he articulated *akedemische Freiheit*, which combined *Lehrfreiheit*, the freedom to teach according to one’s best understanding, and *Lernfreiheit*, a freedom of students to learn in a self-directed way without mere memorization, recitation, and indoctrination. *Lehrfreiheit* encompassed freedom of research inquiry as well as freedom to teach according to one’s judgment, since that judgment should be informed by such inquiry. In that sense, Humboldt considered research a slightly subordinate part of the university’s core mission, supporting the teaching enterprise rather than rivalling it.
zh: 自由主义的个人主义者、普鲁士教育改革家威廉·冯·洪堡，完成了把个人学术自由注入大学这一关键工作；这一融合成了现代意义上的学术自由。在创建新柏林大学时——一个不仅致力于教学、也致力于原创研究（包括文科研究）的机构——他阐明了 *akademische Freiheit*，它把 *Lehrfreiheit*（教 FREE——按自己最好的理解而教的自由）与 *Lernfreiheit*（学的自由——学生自我导向地学习、而不沦为死记硬背、复述与灌输）结合起来。*Lehrfreiheit* 既涵盖研究探究的自由，也涵盖按自己的判断而教的自由，因为那种判断本应以探究为依据。在这个意义上，洪堡把研究视为大学核心使命中稍居从属的部分：它支撑教学事业，而非与之抗衡。

en: Humboldt’s reforms nonetheless initiated the development of what became the model of the research university. It spread past Berlin through Prussia and Germany over the course of the nineteenth century, then began to influence educational innovations in the United States in particular. Johns Hopkins University was founded in 1876 and the University of Chicago in 1890, both private institutions explicitly inspired by the German system, offering the research-based Ph.D. across the arts and sciences disciplines. Those disciplines themselves began to be organized in nationwide associations dedicated to the advancement of research in their respective fields: economics (1885), history (1889), philosophy (1900), political science (1903), and so on, typically led by scholars coming from the German tradition or from one of its new American offshoots, rather than from the older teaching and denominational institutions. Over the rest of the twentieth century, the research university became the dominant model of elite institutions of higher education around the world.
zh: 尽管如此，洪堡的改革开启了后来成为研究型大学之模型的发展。十九世纪间，它越出柏林传遍普鲁士与德意志，随后开始特别地影响美国的教育革新。约翰斯·霍普金斯大学创立于 1876 年，芝加哥大学创立于 1890 年，两者都是明确以德意志体制为范本的私立机构，在文理各学科授予基于研究的博士学位。这些学科本身开始组织成致力于推进各自领域研究的全国性协会：经济学（1885）、历史学（1889）、哲学（1900）、政治学（1903），等等；其领衔者通常来自德意志传统或其新兴的美国分支，而非来自更老的、属于教派的教学机构。在整个二十世纪余下的时间里，研究型大学成了全世界精英高等教育的主导模型。

en: John Dewey received his Ph.D. from Johns Hopkins and joined the Chicago department of philosophy just a few years after the latter university’s founding. During his decade at Chicago, he wrote the first in-depth English-language account of academic freedom, not putting forward any claim to invention (he referred to “the questions summed in the phrase academic freedom,” taking for granted that the phrase was familiar), but setting forth a unified account of its meaning and justifications. The argument noted the accelerating pace and clear value of research in the natural sciences. Dewey stressed the need for comparable progress in the “social and moral sciences,” progress that could only be hoped for if those disciplines cast off the weight of dogma and orthodoxy, as astronomy had once done and evolutionary biology was in the course of doing. He characterized “freedom of inquiry and instruction” as the key distinction between universities and other institutions whose “purpose is to disciple rather than to discipline.” (1902 [2024, 52]) Impairing that freedom, he identified as dealing “a vital wound to the university itself.”
zh: 杜威在约翰斯·霍普金斯获得博士学位，并于芝加哥大学建校数年后加入其哲学系。在芝加哥的十年间，他写出了英语世界中第一篇关于学术自由的深度论述——他并未声称发明了什么（他谈到“概括在学术自由这个短语中的诸问题”，想当然地认定这一说法已为人熟悉），而是给出了关于其含义与证成的统一说明。该论证注意到自然科学研究的加速与明确价值。杜威强调“社会与道德科学”需要可比的进步；而只有当这些学科甩掉教条与正统的重负——如天文学曾经做到、进化生物学正在做的那样——这种进步才有希望。他把“探究与教学的自由”刻画为大学与其他机构的根本区别，后者的“目的在于驯化门徒（disciple），而不在于研求学科（discipline）”（1902 [2024, 52]）。损害这种自由，他视为“对大学本身的一个致命创伤”。

en: Dewey later created the opportunity to give his ideas a lasting impact in 1915 when he cofounded (with the German-trained Johns Hopkins philosopher Arthur Lovejoy), and became the first President of, the American Association of University Professors (AAUP). The formation of the AAUP came in the wake of a wave of faculty firings, mostly in the social sciences, mostly on grounds of political views and statements that were unacceptably radical in the eyes of university leaders, trustees, or donors. While overt religious heterodoxy had traditionally been professionally dangerous in the denominational American teaching colleges, the new research universities faced increasing demands to impose specifically political orthodoxy. Professional disciplinary associations, individually or jointly, initially took the lead in investigating and criticizing such violations. The AAUP replaced those *ad hoc* solutions with a permanent committee on academic freedom, and— crucially— an account of the general principles. Dewey wasn’t himself an author of the 1915 “Declaration of Principles on Academic Freedom and Academic Tenure,” but it is thoroughly faithful to the ideas he had laid out in 1902.
zh: 杜威后来在 1915 年创造了使其理念产生持久影响的机会：他与受过德国训练的约翰斯·霍普金斯哲学家阿瑟·洛夫乔伊共同创立美国大学教授协会（AAUP），并出任首任主席。AAUP 的成立，紧随一波教师解雇潮之后——被解雇者多在社会科学领域，多因在大学领导、校董或捐赠人眼中不可接受地激进的政治观点与言论。虽然露骨的宗教异端在美国教派教学学院中历来是职业危险，新的研究型大学却面临日益增多的施加 ** 政治 ** 正统的要求。各职业学科协会起初单独或联合地带头调查与批评此类侵犯。AAUP 以一个关于学术自由的常设委员会取代了那些 *ad hoc* 办法，并且——至关重要的——提出了关于一般原则的说明。杜威本人并非 1915 年《关于学术自由与终身教职的原则宣言》的执笔者，但该宣言忠实地贯彻了他在 1902 年提出的理念。

en: The AAUP account differs at least in emphasis from Humboldt’s vision in a few ways. One is that it focuses on *Lehrfreiheit*, the rights of professors, and explicitly brackets (without denying) *Lernfreiheit*, the freedom of students. A second is its defense of “extramural utterances,” speech to the general public. And a third is the distinctively Deweyan attitude toward both research and extramural speech, as being *useful* in informing democratic politics with the benefit of expertise. Each of these will be discussed later in this article.
zh: AAUP 的说明与洪堡的愿景至少在强调上有几点不同。其一，它聚焦 *Lehrfreiheit*，即教授的权利，并明确悬置（而非否认）学生的 *Lernfreiheit*。其二，它捍卫“校外言论”——面向普通公众的言论。其三，它对研究与校外言论都持一种鲜明的杜威式态度：它们 ** 有用 **，能以专长裨益民主政治。三者将在本文后文讨论。

en: The 1915 Declaration, the subsequent 1940 AAUP “Statement of Principles on Academic Freedom and Academic Tenure,” and an intervening 1925 joint “Statement of Principles on Academic Freedom and Academic Tenure” between the AAUP and several associations of universities and colleges, have together set out the most influential understanding of the concept and its values, not only in the United States but eventually worldwide. Much subsequent development in the US has taken the form of official commentaries on the 1940 principles. With the twentieth-century rupture in the tradition of academic freedom in German universities, it was the AAUP rules and norms that informed later international documents (*Magna Charta Universitatum* 1988, UNESCO 1997). The concepts that emerged, although contested, are widely shared across national and institutional contexts. As Beaud (2020, 612) puts it, “the language differences do not threaten the existence of a universal idea of academic freedom. Just as there is a single ‘idea of the University’ which enables us to understand that we are talking about the same subject, regardless of where the institution exists, there is a single ‘idea of academic freedom… Proof of the universality of academic freedom can be seen in the way it resists legal or economic requirements in regard to university structuring. It survives regardless of the legal status of universities, be they mostly state-funded, as are the majority in France, Germany and the rest of Europe, or mostly privately funded, as in the United States. In both cases, academic freedom must be acknowledged; only the type of threat to academics themselves changes.” The tradition that runs from Humboldt through Dewey and the AAUP to UNESCO and the *Magna Charta Universitatum* is not univocal but it is continuous and coherent enough to allow analysis of a concept in part through the institutional documents.
zh: 1915 年宣言、随后的 1940 年 AAUP《关于学术自由与终身教职的原则声明》、以及介于其间的 1925 年 AAUP 与多所大学及学院协会的联合《原则声明》，共同确立了关于这一概念及其价值的最有影响的理解——不仅在美国，最终遍及世界。美国其后的发展多采取对 1940 年原则的官方评注的形式。随着德意志大学学术自由传统的二十世纪断裂，正是 AAUP 的规则与规范滋养了后来的国际文件（《大学大宪章》1988；UNESCO 1997）。由此形成的一系列概念虽有争议，却在各国与各制度语境中被广泛分享。正如 Beaud（2020, 612）所言：“语言差异并不威胁学术自由之普遍理念的存在。正如存在单一的‘大学理念’使我们得以明白：无论机构身在何处，我们谈的都是同一个对象，学术自由也存在单一的‘理念’……学术自由之普遍性的证明，可见于它对大学结构方面的法律或经济要求的抵抗。它不因大学的法律地位而存亡——无论大学主要由国家资助（如法国、德国及欧洲其余多数国家），还是主要靠私人资助（如美国）。两种情形下学术自由都必须被承认；改变的只是学人自身所受威胁的类型。”从洪堡经杜威与 AAUP 到 UNESCO 与《大学大宪章》的传统并非单一无歧，但它足够连续与连贯，使我们能够部分地通过制度文件来分析这一概念。

en: In the debates and disagreements that will be surveyed below, the AAUP principles are sometimes the object of interpretive dispute, and are usually a shared point of reference. Differences between the 1915 and 1940 statements, or differences of emphasis between the 1940 statement and subsequent interpretations, are sometimes important, but in general it is common in the literature to treat all of these as varying articulations of a shared underlying set of norms.
zh: 在下文将要综述的争论与分歧中，AAUP 原则有时是解释之争的对象，通常则是共同的参照点。1915 年与 1940 年声明之间的差异，或 1940 年声明与后续解释之间的侧重之别，有时很重要；但一般而言，文献中常见的是把这些文件都当作同一套潜在规范的不同表述。

en: 2. Core ideas
zh: 2 核心观念

en: 2.1 Principles and institutions
zh: 2.1 原则与制度

en: The combined AAUP principles include three core freedoms and two institutions necessary to their realization. The freedoms are, in the 1915 phrasing, “freedom of inquiry and research; freedom of teaching within the university or college; and freedom of extramural utterance and action.” The last will be explained in section 4. The AAUP statement suggested that the freedoms of research and of teaching were the most widely understood aspects of the principle, and the most secure. (The former, at least, probably remains true.) Applications and details may be complicated, but there is something intuitively accessible about the idea that academic freedom means both that scholarly instructors may make their own decisions about what and how to teach, and that scholarly researchers may make their own decisions and about what and how to research, free to follow their arguments and evidence where they lead. “Free” here means both that the decisions aren’t dictated above, whether by university leadership or by state officials or, in an earlier time, by a church; and that scholars won’t be punished (again, by any of those actors) for the decisions they make or the conclusions they reached. “Punishment” encompasses a variety of consequences: not only criminal punishment, but firing, salary cuts, denial of promotion or raises, the elimination of positions, and so on.
zh: AAUP 合并的原则包括三项核心自由与实现它们所必需的两个制度。用 1915 年的话说，这些自由是“探究与研究的自由；大学或学院之内教学的自由；以及校外言论与行动的自由”。最后一项将在第 4 节解释。AAUP 声明提出，研究自由与教学自由是该原则最广为人知、也最有保障的方面（至少前者大概至今如此）。应用与细节可能复杂，但如下想法在直观上易于把握：学术自由意味着教师可以自主决定教什么与怎么教，研究者可以自主决定研究什么与怎么研究，可以让论证与证据把他们带到哪里就是哪里。这里的“自由”兼指：这些决定不由上头规定——无论大学领导层、国家官员，还是早先的教会；而且学者不会因其决定或结论而被（上述任何一方）惩罚。“惩罚”涵盖多种后果：不仅是刑事处罚，还有解雇、减薪、拒绝晋升或加薪、裁撤职位，等等。

en: While this point is perhaps not as widely understood, it is important to stress right away: in the context of *academic* freedom, the freedom to teach and research is always the freedom to do so in accordance with relevant scholarly standards. That fact leads to the two institutions: the security of tenure (Shils 2017)[^shils-2017], with eventual permanent appointment; and decision-making by the scholarly community.
zh: 这一点也许不像前一观点那样广为人知，但须即刻强调：在 ** 学术 ** 自由的语境下，教与研的自由始终是按相关学术标准去教与研的自由。这一事实引出两个制度：终身教职之保障（Shils 2017）[^shils-2017]，即最终的永久聘任；以及由学术共同体做决定。

en: These two institutions are, in the AAUP understanding, deeply connected to each other: any dismissal for cause from academic employment must be approved by a judicial committee “chosen by the faculty senate or council, or by the faculty at large.” Allegations of professional incompetence must be evaluated by members of the department and other relevant departments, and by specialists from the broader academic profession. That is, only the scholarly community can be trusted to police the limits of secure academic appointment. The two institutions are also the crucial guarantors of the freedoms. If the freedom to research and teach are the freedom to do so in accordance with professional standards, there needs to be someone to set and, if needed, enforce those standards. Only fellow members of the profession are authorized to set those standards, or to evaluate compliance with those standards.
zh: 在 AAUP 的理解中，这两个制度彼此深相勾连：任何基于事由的学术解雇，都必须经“由教师评议会或教师大会，或全体教师”选出的司法委员会批准。关于职业不称职的指控，必须由本系与其他相关系的成员、以及来自更大学术职业共同体的专家来评估。也就是说，只有学术共同体才可被信任去守护终身学术聘任的边界。这两个制度也是诸自由的关键担保者。如果研究与教学的自由是按职业标准研究与教学的自由，那就得有人来设定这些标准，并在必要时执行之。只有职业共同体的成员才有资格设定那些标准、或评估对标准的遵守。

en: The freedoms are facets of a rule against orthodoxy; the institutions are those of academic associational self-governance. These two aspects fit together. Freedom of research is the freedom to pursue inquiry where the argument and evidence lead. The appropriate scholarly community is responsible for adjudicating standards of argument and evidence, distinguishing academic research from fraud, falsehood, or fantasy. Freedom of teaching is the freedom to use one’s best pedagogical judgment in teaching the questions and methods that mark a field of study; the field of study itself is shaped by both the intramural scholarly community, e.g. a department, and the extramural, e.g. a discipline.
zh: 诸自由是非正统之规则的不同侧面；两个制度则是学术共同体自我治理的制度。这两方面互相咬合。研究自由，是让探究循着论证与证据走下去的自由；相应的学术共同体负责裁定论证与证据的标准，把学术研究同造假、谬误或幻想区分开来。教学自由，是在讲授标示着一个研究领域的那些问题与方法时运用自己最佳教学判断的自由；而该研究领域本身，既由墙内的学术共同体（如一个系）塑造，也由墙外的学术共同体（如一个学科）塑造。

en: This does introduce a tension at the outset. At some point associational self-governance runs into the individual scholar’s freedom from orthodoxy. An orthodoxy may, after all, be subscribed to and enforced by a department (or centre, college, faculty, and so on; henceforth “department” should be understood as a shorthand for “authoritative self-governing academic unit,” with all the variety that entails in practice and in names). What happens when an individual scholar wants to teach, or study, in ways disapproved of by the relevant governing scholarly community, whether that be a department or centre, a faculty or university, or a field or discipline? No simple answer seems acceptable. Freedom of research must not encompass the freedom to commit research fraud or plagiarism. Freedom of teaching must not mean that the instructor can disregard curricular needs and their job description to teach astrology in lieu of the first semester of an astronomy sequence. But academic freedom that entirely lacks individual *libertas philosophandi* intuitively seems to miss the point; we want freedom for individual minds, not for committees. This entry will not try to resolve this tension in any general way, and various views it surveys will have different implications for resolving it in particular cases.
zh: 这确实在一开始就引入了一种张力。共同体的自我治理终究会撞上学者个人免于正统的自由。毕竟，一种正统可以由一个系（或中心、学院、学部等等；下文“系”应理解为“有权威的自我治理学术单位”的简称，包括实践中与名称上的种种变体）信奉并执行。当一个学者想以相关治理学术共同体不认可的方式去教或去研时——无论那是一个系或中心、一个学部或大学、还是一个领域或学科——会发生什么？没有简单的答案可接受。研究自由不得涵盖造假的自由或剽窃的自由。教学自由也不意味着教师可以无视课程需要与岗位职责，以占星术替代天文学系列课程的第一学期。但一种完全没有个人 *libertas philosophandi* 的学术自由，直观上似乎没有抓住要点；我们要的是给个体心灵的自由，而不是给委员会的自由。本词条不打算以任何一般的方式解决这一张力；它综述的各种观点，对在具体情形中如何化解它会有不同的含义。

en: Although the norms of academic freedom they describe are in this sense partly institutional, the AAUP statements are silent on questions of ultimate enforcement. That is, they do not discuss whether academic freedom ought to be protected by *law*, still less whether it ought to be protected specifically by employment contract law, or by constitutional law, or by statute. The content of the principles is to that extent separated from the question of their official status and mechanisms of guarantee. While the statements’ detailed discussions most often focus on the specific case of the firing of an individual professor, and thus on academic freedom as against the university acting as an employer, the principles are in no way limited to that case. They imply a thorough rejection, for example, of direct state control over the content of university curricula, or the regulation by criminal law of the conclusions of scholarly research. Whether those limitations on state action are to be secured through the forbearance of political actors, through constitutional protection, through any particular governance structure for public universities, and so on is similarly unaddressed.
zh: 虽然 AAUP 各声明所描述的学术自由规范在这个意义上部分地是制度性的，但它们对最终执行问题保持沉默。也就是说，它们不讨论学术自由是否应当由 ** 法律 ** 保护，更不讨论它究竟应当由雇佣合同法、由宪法、还是由制定法来保护。原则的内容，在这一点上与其官方地位及保障机制的问题相分离。虽然各声明的详细讨论最常聚焦于解雇一位教授的具体案例——因而聚焦于学者对抗作为雇主的大学的学术自由——这些原则绝不限于该情形。例如，它们蕴含着对国家直接控制大学课程内容、或以刑法管制学术研究结论的彻底拒斥。至于对这些国家行为之限制应当靠政治行为者的自我克制来保障、靠宪法保护来保障、还是靠公立大学的某种特定治理结构来保障，声明同样未置一词。

en: Some (Finkin 1988, Rabban 2024, Finkin and Post 2009)[^finkin-1988][^finkin-2009][^rabban-2024] have argued that institutional self-governance demands a fourth freedom, extrapolating a freedom of *intramural* speech about university business, “faculty speech that does not involve disciplinary expertise but is instead about the action, policy, or personnel of a faculty member’s home institution” (Finkin and Post 2009, 113)[^finkin-2009]. The practice of self-governance requires the ability to debate and dissent, and thus the collective institution that guarantees academic freedom requires an individual immunity from punishment for speech about a university’s internal affairs. There has been some movement toward formalizing recognition of this principle (AAUP 2006). It is, however, generally thought that scholarly self-governance has been eroding in practice, as an increasing proportion of scholarly instruction is offered by contingently employed faculty who lack permanent status within the university, as official institutions are reformed or abolished by state actors, and as effective decision-making is gradually centralized in a class of professional managers and administrators (Brown 2015, Scott 2019)[^brown-2015][^scott-2019]. United States federal courts have denied that intramural speech by public university employees is protected by the First Amendment in the way that speech connected to research or teaching is, even when institutions of faculty governance are in place (*Porter v. Board of Trustees of North Carolina State University* 2023).
zh: 有些人（Finkin 1988, Rabban 2024, Finkin and Post 2009）[^finkin-1988][^finkin-2009][^rabban-2024]论证：制度自我治理要求第四种自由——他们外推出一种关于校内事务的 ** 墙内 ** 言论自由，“不涉及学科专长、而是关于教师所在院校的行动、政策或人事的教师言论”（Finkin and Post 2009, 113）[^finkin-2009]。自我治理的实践要求能够辩论与异见；因此，保障学术自由的那个集体制度，要求个人就大学内部事务发表言论而免于惩罚的豁免。把这一原则正式化已有一些动向（AAUP 2006）。不过，人们普遍认为学术自我治理在实践中正在被侵蚀：越来越多比例的教学由缺乏校内永久身份的临时聘任教职人员承担；官方制度被国家行为者改革或废除；有效的决策逐渐集中到一个职业管理者与行政人员的阶层（Brown 2015, Scott 2019）[^brown-2015][^scott-2019]。美国联邦法院已否认公立大学雇员的校内言论受第一修正案的保护——不像与研究或教学相联的言论那样受保护——即便教师治理的制度仍然在位（*Porter v. Board of Trustees of North Carolina State University* 2023）。
